{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Great Basin Gas Transmission Company Pipeline System''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://nnbw.com/news/2015/jul/27/blm-oks-natural-gas-pipeline-right-of-way|title=nnbw.com|website=nnbw.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Wieland Flat Compressor Station (Ruby Pipeline interconnect), Nevada to Elko City Gate, Nevada.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://nnbw.com/news/2015/jul/27/blm-oks-natural-gas-pipeline-right-of-way|title=nnbw.com|website=nnbw.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2014/07/21/2014-17046.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==

=== 2015 Elko Area Expansion Project ===
*'''Owner: '''Paiute Pipeline Co<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2014/07/21/2014-17046.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''22 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2014/07/21/2014-17046.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''35 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2014/07/21/2014-17046.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://nnbw.com/news/2015/jul/27/blm-oks-natural-gas-pipeline-right-of-way|title=nnbw.com|website=nnbw.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''8 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://regulations.justia.com/regulations/fedreg/2014/07/21/2014-17046.html|title=regulations.justia.com|website=regulations.justia.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2015-02-03/pdf/2015-01995.pdf|title=govinfo.gov|website=govinfo.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://nnbw.com/news/2015/jul/27/blm-oks-natural-gas-pipeline-right-of-way|title=nnbw.com|website=nnbw.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2014
*'''Start year: '''2015<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
